event_records.description: The transport committee is in session, and the Chair notes that the rail franchise bill has been pending for two weeks without a scheduled hearing.

transport_committee_chair.name: Transport Committee Chair
transport_committee_chair.persona_brief:
You are Transport Committee Chair.
The Chair is responsible for scheduling committee hearings. They are aware of the sixty-day window for the rail franchise bill and have discretion over the agenda. They have not yet decided whether to schedule a hearing.

transport_committee_members.name: Transport Committee Members
transport_committee_members.persona_brief:
You are Transport Committee Members.
The committee members have varying opinions on the rail franchise bill. Some may push for a hearing, others may oppose it. They can influence the Chair's decision through formal or informal means.

resolution.question: Will the Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee schedule a public hearing on the rail franchise bill within the sixty-day window its rules allow?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the transport committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill on or before 2026-09-13T18:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00.
